# PhotoFrame — GitHub Actions

<!-- Generated by Auto (Composer) - 2026-05-30 -->

## Workflows

| Workflow | Trigger | Purpose |
|----------|---------|---------|
| **Build PhotoFrame container** (`build-container.yml`) | Push to `main` (paths filter) or manual | Build image with storage-lib; push to `ghcr.io/<owner>/photoframe` |
| **Deploy PhotoFrame to Azure** (`deploy-azure.yml`) | Manual | Create/update ACI instance with storage + Google env vars |

## Required secrets

| Secret | Used by |
|--------|---------|
| `AZURE_CREDENTIALS` | Deploy |
| `AZURE_STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING` | Deploy (when storage_provider=azure) |
| `GOOGLE_PHOTOS_CLIENT_ID` | Deploy |
| `GOOGLE_PHOTOS_CLIENT_SECRET` | Deploy (secure) |
| `GOOGLE_PHOTOS_REFRESH_TOKEN` | Deploy (secure) |

`GITHUB_TOKEN` is provided automatically for ghcr.io login during deploy.

## Quick start

1. Configure secrets (see [README/AZURE_DEPLOYMENT.md](../README/AZURE_DEPLOYMENT.md)).
2. Run **Build PhotoFrame container** → wait for `ghcr.io/.../photoframe:main`.
3. Run **Deploy PhotoFrame to Azure** → choose `storage_provider` (`azure` or `filesystem`).

Full instructions: **[README/AZURE_DEPLOYMENT.md](../README/AZURE_DEPLOYMENT.md)**.
